summary: acer nitro 16 gaming system experiencing battery drain issue while plugged in, with gradual decline from 100% to 55% after 7-8 hours of gameplay despite reducing graphics settings to Medium.
detected_fault: Power management issue related to insufficient power adapter wattage (135W) and potential driver/BiOS version compatibility issues.
suggested_solution: Monitor battery life, adjust power settings, consider using a higher-wattage power adapter (e.g., 230W), update drivers and BIOS to recommended versions.
